title: About
intro: Flerapii is a browser extension for managing both third-party New API-compatible relay sites and your own New API instance. It centralizes account and balance monitoring, smart sorting, and site detection, and provides automation features such as auto-refresh and temp-window firewall bypass. For self-hosted New API, it also offers channel management and model list synchronization, and integrates with CLIProxyAPI, WebDAV backup, and import/export tools.

thanksDesc: Thanks to all developers who have contributed to the open source community, the development of this plugin benefits from these excellent open source projects and tools
privacyText: Flerapii is local-first: extension data stays in your browser by default. Data is only transmitted to external services when you explicitly configure and use optional features (for example, your own relay endpoints or WebDAV backup).
